name: MonarchSearchResults
title: SearchResults
wrapsNative: List with .listStyle(.plain) and a Section per group, rows of MonarchSearchResultItem; MonarchErrorState, MonarchEmptyState and redacted(reason: .placeholder) skeleton rows for the states
summary: Search results in labelled groups with counts, highlighted matches, a summary that is announced, Show all buttons, and loading, empty and error states.
whenToUse: As the content of a search screen, usually with .searchable, when results come back in groups (documents, people, projects) or as one list.
whenNotToUse: For suggestions while typing, use .searchSuggestions. For one result row elsewhere, use MonarchSearchResultItem.
api: init(groups: [MonarchSearchResultGroup], query: String = "", isLoading: Bool = false, isFailed: Bool = false, errorMessage: String? = nil, loadingRows: Int = 4, labels: MonarchSearchResultsLabels = MonarchSearchResultsLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onShowAll: (@MainActor (MonarchSearchResultGroup) -> Void)? = nil, onSelect: @escaping @MainActor (MonarchSearchResult, MonarchSearchResultGroup) -> Void)
struct MonarchSearchResultGroup: Identifiable { init(_ title: String?, id: String, results: [MonarchSearchResult], total: Int? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil) }

struct MonarchSearchResult: Identifiable { init(_ title: String, id: String, path: [String] = [], snippet: String? = nil, titleRanges: [Range<Int>]? = nil, snippetRanges: [Range<Int>]? = nil, snippetHasMarkTags: Bool = false, systemImage: String? = nil, fileName: String? = nil, meta: String? = nil) }

struct MonarchSearchResultsLabels { var summary: ((Int, String) -> String)?; var loading: String?; var emptyTitle: ((String) -> String)?; var emptyMessage, errorTitle, retry: String?; var showAll: ((String?, Int) -> String)?; var groupCount: ((Int) -> String)? }

options.name: groups
options.description: Results in groups; a group with a nil title has no heading, for results without groups. Empty groups are left out.

options.name: query
options.description: What the person searched for: its words are highlighted and it is named in the summary and empty title.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: A search is running: skeleton rows when there are no results yet, otherwise the results stay and the summary reads Searching….

options.name: isFailed
options.description: The search failed: an error state replaces the results.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: The reason, shown under Search failed.

options.name: loadingRows
options.description: Skeleton rows while loading with no results.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string; counted strings are closures.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds Try again to the error state.

options.name: onShowAll
options.description: Adds "Show all 24 in Documents" after a group whose total is larger than its results.

states.name: ready
states.description: The summary line, then the groups with headings, counts and highlighted rows.

states.name: refreshing
states.description: Results stay, the summary reads Searching… with a small spinner.

states.name: loading
states.description: Redacted skeleton rows, hidden from VoiceOver.

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState (filtered kind) with "No results for “query”" and a hint.

states.name: error
states.description: MonarchErrorState with Search failed, the message and Try again.

appearance: The summary and counts in the muted text role, headings in the default text role, counts on a muted capsule, rows from MonarchSearchResultItem with matches on the subtle warning fill. The list background is cleared so the screen's canvas shows, in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web results are one Tab stop with arrow-key navigation; on iOS each result is a button in a List and VoiceOver moves through them in order, with the Headings rotor on group headings. The web's heading level and custom empty node are not offered; the web's linkComponent and href become onSelect. The web shows results without groups when given results instead of groups; here pass one group with a nil title. Android has the same parameters. Several closures are optional (onRetry, onShowAll). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is onRetry.
accessibility: The summary is announced when it changes (results count, Searching…, or the empty title), as the web's live region; Search failed is announced when the search fails.
Group headings have the header trait and are read with their count, such as "Documents, 24 results"; the icon is decorative.
Each result is a button read as title, location path, snippet and meta (from MonarchSearchResultItem).
Skeleton rows are hidden from VoiceOver.
The empty and error states keep their own accessibility (header titles, retry button).
Rows are at least 44 points tall and text scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: A total smaller than the results shown is raised to the number shown.
An error wins over results and loading; results win over loading.
A query of only spaces is treated as no query in the summary and empty title.
The List scrolls itself, so do not put the results inside another ScrollView; give the screen the full height.

examples.title: Grouped results
examples.code:
MonarchSearchResults(
    groups: [
        MonarchSearchResultGroup(
            "Documents",
            id: "documents",
            results: [
                MonarchSearchResult(
                    "Travel policy",
                    id: "doc-1",
                    path: ["Handbook", "Policies"],
                    snippet: "Book travel at least two weeks ahead and share the plan with your team.",
                    meta: "Policy"
                ).metaAsBadge(),
                MonarchSearchResult(
                    "Team travel checklist",
                    id: "doc-2",
                    path: ["Operations"],
                    snippet: "Passports, insurance and a contact sheet for every trip."
                ),
            ],
            total: 8,
            systemImage: "tray"
        ),
        MonarchSearchResultGroup(
            "Events",
            id: "events",
            results: [
                MonarchSearchResult(
                    "Travel planning review",
                    id: "event-1",
                    path: ["Calendar"],
                    meta: "Thursday"
                ),
            ],
            systemImage: "calendar"
        ),
        MonarchSearchResultGroup(
            "People",
            id: "people",
            results: [
                MonarchSearchResult(
                    "Alex Kim",
                    id: "person-1",
                    snippet: "Travel coordinator"
                ),
            ],
            systemImage: "person.2"
        ),
    ],
    query: "travel",
    onShowAll: { _ in },
    onSelect: { _, _ in }
)
.frame(height: 760)

examples.title: A failed search with retry
examples.code:
MonarchSearchResults(
    groups: [],
    isFailed: isFailed,
    errorMessage: "The search service did not respond.",
    onRetry: { isFailed = false },
    onSelect: { _, _ in }
)
